svg.title: Project introduction
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: STFE 2027 — Smart Trade Fair & Expo — is a three-day exhibition in Agra for
entrepreneurs, startups and MSMEs. This case study covers the complete
identity: the final logo system, colour and type, the exhibition and print
applications, a lead-generation campaign and the exhibitor landing page,
concepts · social and ad creatives · landing
All exhibition and print applications in this case study are design concepts. Photography is illustrative and supplied by the organiser — not of a previous STFE edition.
